notes: Python timing is static scanner evidence, not Unity Burst profiler proof.
Both legacy binary search and B-Tree traversal read packed byte blobs through struct.unpack_from.
The cache-line delta is topology-derived and independent of Python interpreter overhead.

evidence.residualRisk: Unity import and runtime Vault relocation/stale-generation proof pending.

evidence.residualRisk: Unity import and runtime Vault relocation/stale-generation proof pending.

evidence.artifact: ConstructionManager exposes internal GetSpawnedModuleAt(int), and HabitatConstructionManager structural graph/signature rebuilds now consume ModuleCount plus GetSpawnedModuleAt instead of IReadOnlyList<GameObject> SpawnedModules.

evidence.residualRisk: A ConstructionManager-owned immutable topology snapshot remains the stronger future route; runtime profiler proof pending.

evidence.residualRisk: Profiler/GCMonitor proof pending.

evidence.claim: XR pipe preview no longer uses legacy pointer-bearing VaultBufferHandle descriptors, GlobalSignals runtime-origin fallback, or Unity Time.frameCount for its presentation payload.

evidence.residualRisk: Runtime builder smoke proof for duplicate serialized cost rows remains pending; Inventory-owned reserve/commit API remains future route work.

evidence.artifact: HabitatConstructionManager no longer declares _costHashBuffer/_costRemainingBuffer/_costRemovedBuffer/_costItemBuffer; HasBuildResources and ConsumeBuildResources use stackalloc int[MaxCostCapacity] spans for grouped costs and rollback counters.
